title: user.merged
description: Consumed from stapel-auth. An anonymous guest account was absorbed into an existing account; the guest row ceases to exist. Analytics re-owns the guest's Funnel rows onto the surviving account. The event stream is NOT re-keyed: stapel_core.eventstore is append/query/rollup/purge with no update, so a subject re-key would be a non-atomic read-append-purge that double-counts a person's history if it is interrupted — the guest's rows keep their own user_hash until that primitive exists in core. Contract owned by the emitter.
